prompt_text: What is the best service to check if AI engines like ChatGPT recommend my small business?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer
- To check whether AI assistants (ChatGPT, Bing Chat, Bard, Perplexity, Claude) will recommend your business, use a combination of:
  1. a live-answer AI that shows sources (Perplexity.ai or Bing Chat / ChatGPT with browsing), and
  2. a local-listings management service to make sure the AI has good, authoritative data (Yext is the most comprehensive paid option; free core: Google Business Profile + Bing Places + Yelp + Apple Maps).

Why two things
- AI assistants either synthesize from the web/knowledge graphs or from their training. To “check” what they recommend you need to query live models that cite sources (Perplexity, Bing Chat, ChatGPT with browsing).  
- To increase the chance they recommend you, you must make sure the major knowledge sources (Google Business Profile, Yelp, data aggregators) contain accurate, well-structured information. Services like Yext, BrightLocal, Moz Local or Whitespark help push and monitor those listings across directories and aggregators.

Recommended workflow
1. Claim and optimize local listings (free / essential)
   - Google Business Profile (Google Maps / Search): verify, set categories, hours, photos, services, posts, Q&A.  
   - Bing Places, Apple Maps, Yelp, Facebook.  
2. Push your data to aggregators
   - Use Yext (enterprise/paid) or alternatives (Data Axle / Foursquare / Infogroup via your local SEO tool) so directory networks and knowledge graphs have consistent data.  
3. Add structured data to your website
   - Implement schema.org/LocalBusiness markup (name, address, phone, hours, geo, services) and markup for reviews.  
4. Collect reviews and respond
   - More (good) reviews on Google/Yelp/etc. increase visibility and trust signals that AIs use.  
5. Monitor/track
   - Tools: BrightLocal, Whitespark, Moz Local, SEMrush Local for citations, rankings and review monitoring.  
6. Test AI recommendations
   - Query multiple live models (Perplexity, Bing Chat, Google Bard, ChatGPT with browsing, Claude Realtime) using local, intent-based prompts and compare answers and sources.

Best single picks
- If you want one service to improve the odds your business gets recommended: Yext (paid) — it pushes your authoritative business data to many knowledge graph consumers and is widely-used by platforms that feed AI assistants.  
- If you want one service to test whether AI will recommend you and see sources: Perplexity.ai (free/paid tiers) — it returns succinct answers and shows the URLs it used.

Sample prompts to test AIs
- “I’m in [city, ZIP]. Recommend a [service type] near me — top 3 options and why.”  
- “What are the best [your-business-type] in [your neighborhood or ZIP]? Is [Your Business Name] one of them?”  
- “Find a [service] open now near [address].”  
Run these in Perplexity, ChatGPT with browsing/Bing Chat, and Bard. Compare results and note whether your business appears and which sources are cited.

Limitations to keep in mind
- ChatGPT without browsing uses its training data and may be out-of-date; use browsing-enabled versions or web-first models for current recommendations.  
- AI outputs vary by model, region, and prompt; there’s no single “AI index” you can register with.  
- Improving listings and schema increases the chance of being recommended but does not guarantee placement.

If you want, tell me:
- your business type + city (and whether you want a free or paid route), and I’ll:
  - give a prioritized checklist for listings and schema,
  - suggest exact prompts to test each model,
  - or run a quick set of test prompts and show what the major AIs return (you’d need to copy/paste their outputs).
